summary: Iteration 13 frontend-only mobile-web tests for the /deep-dive/[id] intro screen and /(tabs)/discover. All requested checks PASS: full title renders without ellipsis for both /deep-dive/v4-caffe-espresso (82 chars) and /deep-dive/v5-lez-muscoli (80 chars); both dividers deep-dive-divider-title and deep-dive-divider-intro exist; cover card height reasonable (348-349px at 390x844 and 249px at 390x700, all > 150); deep-dive-start bottom fits within the viewport at both 390x844 and 390x700; scroll animation on 'Leggi la storia' is gradual (14 unique scrollTop samples over 1.5s with values increasing monotonically e.g. [0..5,21,58,124,197,333,507,696,771,815,833,843,844]) and ends at chapter 1 exactly (deep-dive-page-chapter-1 bbox at 0,0). Home discover: home-category-list renders 8 tiles with visible labels, tile h/w ratio 1.12 matches spec, active card's -category-icon is an (3D artwork src=/api/category-media/scienza) not

ui_bugs.issue: Top-bar story title uses numberOfLines={2} and is visibly truncated with an ellipsis on long titles (e.g. v4-caffe-espresso shows 'Come l\'Italia ha inventato l\'espresso (e perché non è stata...'). The review request states titles must NEVER be truncated anywhere. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/reader-header.tsx:60

react_native_issues.issue: Web console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Appears on the two hairline LinearGradient dividers in /app/frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx:331,339.

Web console warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow' shorthand. Multiple styles in /app/frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx (coverTitle, introEyebrow, hook) still use textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius.

Web console warning: '[Reanimated] Selected easing is not currently supported on web. Using linear easing instead.' at /app/frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx:160. Not blocking (animation still gradual — 14 unique scrollTop samples), but produces a noisy log on every deep-dive open.

action_items: Remove numberOfLines={2} from ReaderHeader title (or replace with a length-based font-size scaling like CoverTitle) to honor the 'no truncation anywhere' rule.
Optional: move pointerEvents='none' from JSX prop to style.pointerEvents on the two divider LinearGradients in /app/frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx to silence the deprecation warning.
Optional: consolidate textShadow* into the shorthand textShadow to silence the deprecation warning on web.
Optional: swap Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic) for a web-supported easing (or gate on Platform.OS !== 'web') to avoid the Reanimated warning on every deep-dive open.
critical_code_review_comments: CoverTitle in /app/frontend/app/deep-dive/[id].tsx correctly scales fontSize by title length and removes numberOfLines — good fix that meets the spec on the cover. However the same principle was not applied to ReaderHeader title, which still truncates.
cardH computation subtracts sheetH (measured lazily). Initial sheetH default 430 is used before layout; verified this still yields cover height > 150 on 390x700 (249px). Reasonable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on requested items; 1 additional truncation issue found in ReaderHeader

context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested intro-screen assertions pass on both /deep-dive/v4-caffe-espresso and /deep-dive/v5-lez-muscoli at 390x844 and 390x700. deep-dive-start scroll produces a ~0.9s Reanimated animation on web (14 unique scrollTop samples increasing from 0 to full page height). Home /(tabs)/discover tiles are compacted (h/w=1.12) and the active card's category chip icon is a 3D . One additional finding beyond the request: ReaderHeader (top bar) title uses numberOfLines={2} in /app/frontend/src/components/reader-header.tsx:60 and truncates long titles with '...' — contradicts the 'never truncate titles anywhere' rule.
rca_of_issue: The intro-screen truncation fix was applied to the CoverTitle component only; the ReaderHeader's title also displays the story title (at the top of every reader page) and still caps at 2 lines with ellipsis. Fix: remove numberOfLines or use a length-based font-size like CoverTitle for the header title as well.
